claims.says: traverse climber's-left (south) below Horsefly Pass, holding around 6,400 ft ... to gain Corteo's southeast ridge at about 7,000 ft ... toward a notch at roughly 7,900-7,920 ft just east of the summit block
Southeast ridge to the notch

Climb the Southeast Face/Southwest Ridge to the summit

contradictions.why: Three incompatible ascent lines are described for one route: a southeast-ridge/Horsefly Pass traverse to a 7,900 ft notch east of the summit (approach, climbing_route, approach_variants), a south-slope traverse to the SW ridge at 7,400 ft (beta), and a Lewis Glacier ascent to a 7,500 ft notch then a cirque downclimb (waypoints, itinerary, timing, hazards).
